plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero.
Trim broad index (SPY) to 20% to reduce concentration and build cash.
Add to income ETF (QQQI) to 15% for stability.

conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for lower, steadier returns around 1.5% per month. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leverage and diversifying away from tech concentration, accepting lower growth potential.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to minimal levels.
Reduce broad index (SPY) to 25% to address concentration.
Buy Gold (GLD) for diversification.

balanced.read: This balanced strategy targets around 2.5% monthly returns by blending growth and risk management. It reduces leverage and concentration while adding a defensive asset and a quality tech name.

plan: Increase leveraged semiconductor ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to 6% each.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% monthly returns by increasing leverage and concentrating on top-rated tech setups. It accepts substantially higher risk, including amplified drawdowns and the daily decay of leveraged ETFs.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero.
Increase income ETF (QQQI) to 30% for steady distributions.
